admission_dependency: platform/trusted_apps.py concrete TrustedAppAdmission and owner-issued VerifiedAppBundle; no boolean, digest assertion, caller verifier or default publisher root

partition.identity: exact trusted principal identifier plus exact https://<app_id>.<publisher>.apps.hepta.invalid origin
partition.digest_preimage: domain bytes plus ASCII canonical JSON [principal, exact_origin]
partition.handle: store-issued opaque InstalledApp, bound to creating store and active install sequence
partition.caller_authentication: trusted host boundary obligation; a caller-supplied principal string is not engine authentication

custody.root: already provisioned absolute canonical service-UID directory, exact mode 0700
custody.ancestors: retained O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW descriptors and complete absolute-chain identity/mode/owner rechecks
custody.lease: .app-storage.lock, regular service-owned mode 0600, zero bytes, one link, retained exclusive nonblocking flock; no inherited child LOCK_UN
custody.files: flat derived names, O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, regular service-owned mode 0600 and one link; retain writing fd through file and directory fsync, named-inode checks and full readback

lifecycle.version_profile: stable canonical uint32 SemVer triple; strict numeric increase, including after uninstall; prerelease storage unsupported
lifecycle.transaction: prepare_install accepts this admission owner's verified immutable bundle and issues a concrete plan bound to store, policy snapshot and event sequence; commit_install revalidates current policy, exact plan, published ZIP and signature before and after commit
lifecycle.assets: deterministic classic ZIP_STORED snapshot, fixed regular-file metadata, every member obtained from admitted immutable bytes; stored complete archive re-admitted with real current Ed25519 on open
lifecycle.uninstall: durable logical tombstone, invalidates old handles; version floor, signed assets, app data and all history retained
lifecycle.reinstall: strictly higher stable version and identical signed data_schema_version; previously retained app data remains in this exact partition
lifecycle.migration: unsupported; any data_schema_version change including omission/addition refuses before lifecycle intent

data.key: one canonical portable ASCII asset-path segment, no traversal, slash, backslash, percent encoding, hidden name, trailing dot or Windows device basename; exact case-sensitive identity
data.value: immutable bytes, logically replaced by a new immutable artifact; deletion publishes a retained tombstone
data.namespace: same principal and exact synthetic origin, with current active install handle and current publisher policy required
data.quotas: retained history and tombstoned key identities remain counted; quotas never trigger deletion

policy.provisioning: externally authenticated actual admission owner; page/model/bundle may not configure roots, clock or owner
policy.durable_floor: synchronize_policy persists actual policy revision, roots, cumulative revocations and seen key pins before use; lower revision, changed same revision, pin rebinding/removal or revoked-key removal refuses across clean restart
policy.refused_target_or_capacity: persist a newly observed compatible policy before target-key refusal; inability to record that snapshot, including pre-intent capacity failure, keeps owner unresolved and refuses restart rather than forgetting a revocation
policy.current_revalidation: every active asset/data/lifecycle operation checks the actual owner's current key validity, revocation, freshness and exact issuer binding
policy.clock: now_unix must be a fresh authenticated host-clock sample; no configured clock, monotonic expiry clock or backward-time latch; untrusted/frozen/replayed timestamps cannot establish current validity
policy.historical_consistency: reopen parses bounded historical ZIPs and complete index to bind persisted floor metadata; historical records grant no execution authority; current open must reverify real signature

durability.protocol: fsync owner open record before mutations; fsync intent, immutable artifact and commit separately with directory barriers and retained-fd custody/readback; clean owner receipt only after all operations succeed
durability.persistent_refusal: unresolved owner open, intent without commit, orphan/malformed/substituted artifact or close refusal artifact blocks future owners; no automatic retry, recovery, history pruning or acknowledgement boolean
durability.return_window: observed in-operation interruption after durable commit preserves unresolved session and refuses restart; final callee return callback may lose response after protected region while known durable commit remains terminal, but consumed operation/plan/version cannot replay; caller delivery is not proven
durability.close_barrier_failure: retain clean candidate plus best-effort explicit refused artifact; failure preventing marker creation or persistence cannot be solved without external storage custody
durability.operator_recovery: not implemented; store remains refused until an independently specified authenticated recovery protocol exists

owner: creating process and Python thread; nonreentrant; copied fork authority refuses
garbage_collection: descriptor-only cleanup, detach all lease/chain/root ownership before any close, attempt each detached fd despite errors, no retry by integer, no explicit LOCK_UN, no thread authority check, no clean receipt or history deletion; unresolved owner still refuses reopening
remaining_obligations: authenticated external policy/time/root provisioning and protected rollback anchor
native context principal binding, exact-origin interception and storage-engine enforcement
revocation of already running native app contexts and loaded code
trusted installed app approval, activation and uninstall UX
authenticated operator recovery and history retention/capacity policy
transactional supported schema migration protocol and independent installed fault corpus
